facts.fact: According to Keynes Digital CRO Chris Chen, businesses with a monthly ad spend of at least $200,000 can benefit from CTV without compromising other marketing efforts.
facts.quote: Businesses with a monthly ad spend of at least $200,000 can benefit from CTV without compromising other marketing efforts.

facts.fact: Chris Chen advises that advertisers spending at least $200,000 a month can allocate a 10-15% budget to CTV without putting the business in financial harm's way.
facts.quote: Advertisers that are spending at least $200,000 a month can allocate a small 10-15% budget without putting the business in financial harm's way.

facts.fact: Chris Chen says that both 15-second and 30-second spots are effective for CTV campaigns, depending on the complexity of the message.
facts.quote: Both 15-second and 30-second spots are effective, depending on the complexity of the message.

facts.fact: Chris Chen says Keynes Digital would insert 15-second and 30-second non-skippable ads during premium content whenever possible.
facts.quote: If we can insert 15- and 30-second non-skippable ads during premium content, we'll do it," says Chen.

facts.fact: The page defines CTV as the delivery of internet-based video content on television sets.
facts.quote: CTV refers to the delivery of internet-based video content on television sets.

facts.fact: Filmkraft's listed office address is 28-07 Jackson Ave, 5th Floor, Long Island City, NY 11101.
